description:
YT Music Morphe in Waze's built-in audio player.

**Show list displays supported Home recommendations and mixes, not your personal Library.** Speed dial is included, with configurable named Home shelves. Available content depends on the installed Morphe client.

Compatibility is **Any Waze version** with matching audio-SDK fingerprints. Tested on original Waze and deWaze 5.24.5.0 with YT Music Morphe 9.30.53. Unsupported SDK layouts fail patching clearly; future-version compatibility is not guaranteed.

Apply this single patch on top of Waze or deWaze. No YT Music client changes are required.

## 1.0.0 (2026-11-01)

### Features

* add YT Music Morphe Home content to Waze ([c8060b7](https://github.com/[secure]/waze-audio-patches/commit/c8060b71c3faaa3fecb4c329b57d392b743b38d7))

options.description: Comma separated package names of patched YouTube Music apps. Installed repackaged YouTube Music apps are also detected automatically.
Home section titles separated by |, matching the language used in YT Music. Speed dial is always included. Only sections returned by the installed Morphe client are shown.
